designMatrix.title: raw CLI/QMP/storage API bypass
designMatrix.passCondition: 无 lease/未验证设备无法附加，限制操作无法绕过
designMatrix.sourceEvidence: 依赖 S15 的真实 Static run；QMP component 只覆盖一个端点，raw CLI/storage/API/alternate monitor/fd injection 与 end-to-end lease gate 待实现

assertions.statement: 无 lease/未验证设备无法附加，限制操作无法绕过
an unmanaged request cannot launch or mutate a DirectPath QEMU process without an admitted durable lease
API, CLI, QMP, storage, alternate-monitor and fd-injection bypass attempts fail before backend mutation
replay and concurrency do not change assignment generation, lease, VFIO fds or guest topology
every production denial is tied to peer identity, policy hash and request digest without logging raw secrets

designMatrix.title: QEMU/kernel/firmware/policy 升级
designMatrix.passCondition: 依赖风险自动 invalidated，重验收前关闭
designMatrix.sourceEvidence: Case 已定义为 `IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED`；component key/content/current-epoch gate 不等于 production key rotation/catalog/dependency invalidation

assertions.statement: 依赖风险自动 invalidated，重验收前关闭
every supported profile binds exact dependency versions and retained qualification evidence hashes
an observed dependency digest or signer change invalidates all affected supported claims
invalidated profiles are denied by API, scheduler, host agent and launcher until re-qualified
unrelated profiles remain available when their complete dependency set is unchanged
